purpose: Final bounded pass: point-in-time official evidence inventory for SHFE historical exchange transaction margin / transaction fee / close-today fee / close-previous fee / price-limit for cu, al, ni, au, ag, rb over 2024-01-01..2025-12-31. Adds official static attachment bindings discovered via search-engine URL discovery and downloaded directly from the SHFE official domain.
search_engine_usage: URL_DISCOVERY_ONLY (DuckDuckGo lite). No value from any search snippet was asserted as a binding value; all bound values were extracted from SHFE official artifact bytes.
retrieval_note: Live SHFE site (www.shfe.com.cn) serves a WAF bot-challenge page for all HTML notice paths (re-verified this pass: STATUS 200 but body is the Safeline challenge page). Direct static-file downloads of W-prefixed notice attachments (W*.doc / W*.docx) succeed without the HTML challenge and are the primary bound evidence. Wayback Machine (web.archive.org) CDX and availability APIs still return HTTP 429; archive.today 429 (consistent with V0_1). Search engines are used only to discover official static attachment URLs and notice references; no search-snippet numeric value is asserted as authority. Downloaded copyrighted .doc/.docx bytes are hashed and extracted but are NOT committed to the repository; only reference, hash, and structured extracted facts are recorded.

gaps.detail: Exchange trading-margin (交易所交易保证金比例) schedule over the window is not bound for any product as a continuous schedule. This pass added point-in-time margin bindings for au/ag (2024-05-23: 套保11/投机12; AG2602 2025-12-10: 套保16/一般17) and a reference-only au/ag margin point (2025-10-17). No exchange margin is bound for cu, al, ni, rb. Intermediate adjustment history within the window remains unbounded.

No full official transaction-fee schedule bound for these products in the window. This pass bound special-contract hedging fees for ni (NI2408/NI2409), rb (RB2501), and silver hedging-fee schedule; the general (非套保) transaction-fee schedule for cu/al/ni/rb and silver over the window is not bound. Monthly fee-schedule pages remain WAF-blocked.
No bound official close-today fee for cu/al/ni/rb general positions over the window; silver close-today bound only for AG2602/AG2604 at the 2025-12-24 point. No fabricated value.
No bound official close-previous fee for these products.

Fee basis for cu/al/ni/rb general transaction fees in the window not bound. au bound as per-lot (2025-04/05 points); ag bound as per-turnover (2025-12 point; hedging schedule 2024-07). rb hedging bound as ‰ (2024-07 point) but general basis not bound.
Gold/silver fee values bound only at specific points (au: 2025-04-23, 2025-05-14; ag: 2025-12-24). Values before/between these points not established.
Mid-window adjustment effective dates for many notices not byte-bound (notice HTML WAF-blocked; effective dates for most found attachments are per-notice-reference only).

Price-limit (涨跌停板幅度) adjustments bound only for au/ag at 2024-05-23 (10%) and AG2602 at 2025-12-10 (15%). cu/al/ni/rb price-limit schedule over the window not bound (contract-text ±3%/±4% bound only).

Official notice HTML pages and monthly fee-schedule pages remain WAF-blocked on the live SHFE site; web archives rate-limited. A future pass with changed official access conditions or new sources may recover additional official bytes. Recorded, not bypassed.

finalization_policy.rationale: This is the final bounded source-acquisition pass for E-06. Remaining gaps are recorded explicitly and are not to be re-acquired through open-ended repeated crawling. A repeat is authorized only if an official access condition changes, a new formal source appears, or the Owner changes the source policy. This is not a lowering of accuracy standards; it prevents the project from stalling on repeated scraping. UNKNOWN/NOT_SPECIFIED is preserved over inference.

completeness_judgment.rationale: Contract-text minimum transaction margins bound for all six products (V0_1). This pass added official byte-bound point-in-time evidence: gold fee schedule (2025-05-14), silver fee schedule (2025-12-24, per-turnover basis), gold/silver exchange trading margin (2024-05-23), AG2602 exchange margin (2025-12-10), and special-contract hedging fees for ni/au/rb (2024-07-15). However, no continuous point-in-time exchange-level fee/margin schedule exists for any product over the full window; exchange margins for cu/al/ni/rb and general transaction-fee schedules for cu/al/ni/rb (and silver) are unbound. Therefore the outcome is NOT COMPLETE_BUILDABLE. The elevated margin periods (e.g., au/ag 2024-05 onward) have no bound reversal dates.
